title: Creamy Baked Spinach Pasta
subtitle: Creamy spinach pasta, finished under a Parmesan crust
description: Fusilli in a garlicky spinach cream sauce, topped with Parmesan and baked until golden.

ingredients.note: plus more for the pasta water

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180°C fan (200°C conventional / 400°F). Bring about 4 litres of salted water to a boil and cook the {{pasta}} to al dente per the packet, then drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, warm the {{oil}} with the {{garlic}} until fragrant, about 1 minute.
Add the {{spinach}} and the {{salt}}. Stir until it starts to wilt, then cover and cook until fully wilted.
Stir in the {{cream}} and bring to a simmer. Cover and cook, then stir in the {{nutmeg}} and {{pepper}} if using.
Add the drained {{pasta}} and stir to coat, breaking up any clumps of greens so they spread evenly. Cover and cook so the pasta drinks up some of the sauce.
Stir in the {{parmesan}} until melted through and well mixed.
Grease a baking dish with the {{butter}}, tip in the pasta, and scatter the {{parmesan-top}} over the top. Bake until melted and golden.
Serve hot, with extra Parmesan at the table.

notes: The source recipe doesn't bake — the buttered dish, Parmesan topping and 15-minute bake are our additions.
Bakes at 180°C fan (about 200°C conventional / 400°F). Go hotter for a browner crust or lower for a gentler melt.
For a strictly vegetarian version, use a Parmesan made without animal rennet.

nutrition.note: Rough estimate for the baked version, per serving of four.
